description: Synthetic retained authority entry-query snapshots across synchronous publication callbacks.
scope: Local reference API replay. Actions are selected by the test adapter, not serialized callback code or policy authority. Fixed external governance, manifest signatures and RFC 3161 proofs are authenticated independently of the query decision. This does not widen governed document algorithms or establish a remote document attack.
timeEncoding: baseQuery uses canonical CBOR integer instants. JSON case overrides preserve the explicitly represented fractional numeric values; the full query is not canonical-CBOR-cloned.
